files.description: The sole EHI export documentation PDF (7 pages). Contains overview of the C-CDA export mechanism, two screenshots of the export UI (single patient and population export), and a data dictionary listing 21 C-CDA sections with their element names. Created 2025-11-18 by Hemant J. Patel. Title page says version 22.0 but current product is v25.0.

The AngularJS template for the EHI export page. Contains the page text describing the export and a link to the PDF. The main site is an AngularJS SPA that fails to render in browsers, so this template was fetched directly.

Browser screenshot of the EHI export page. Shows a blank/white page with only a 'Scroll' link — the AngularJS SPA failed to render, confirming the site's JavaScript rendering issues noted in product research.
